usageNote: 日常叮嘱用语，妈妈/天气预报最爱说！语气像关心提醒，超实用的出门前对话！

examples.en: Don't forget to take your umbrella with you — it's going to rain this afternoon.
examples.zh: 别忘了带上雨伞，今天下午会下雨的。

examples.en: Mom always says, 'Take your umbrella with you!' even when the sky looks clear.
examples.zh: 妈妈总是说'带上雨伞！'，即使天看起来晴朗。
